record.body:
## Description

Prove the phase exit criteria hold together: drive `scripts/close_batch.py` as the real entry point for the close gate, then the skill consistency checks. Do not edit the tree.

## Approach

1. Run the red_first close_batch tests (refusal, ancestry, dirty red, escape, other methods) through pytest as the integration gate for the script entry point.
2. Run skill/contract consistency (and any red-first wording assert) without modifying skills or scripts.
3. Return pass/fail evidence only; leave the work-item for the parent to close.
record.subject: verify-red-first
